observed.caption: A wide tree-lined divided avenue with vehicles on the road, pedestrians on sidewalks, and tall buildings in the background under an overcast sky.
observed.description: A wide divided urban roadway with two carriageways separated by a paved central median extends into the distance, flanked on both sides by green metal fences and mature leafy trees. A red hatchback car and two motorcycles with riders travel on the left carriageway in the foreground, while additional vehicles are visible further down the road and white cars are parked along the right sidewalk. Groups of pedestrians are gathered and walking behind the fences on both sidewalks. Tall modern high-rise buildings with glass facades rise behind the trees on the left, with additional buildings visible in the far background. The sky is overcast and the lighting is diffuse daylight.
